About me

I’m building FixItNow AI, an AI-powered technician that can diagnose machine and appliance problems and generate personalized, step-by-step repair videos. I’m also the author of ZERO TO AI UNICORN, a book about building an AI unicorn company. Alongside these projects, I’m part of Robocon LDCE, a national-champion robotics club, and I enjoy working with ambitious builders and teams.
